_**Agent (claude-opus-4-6 2026-03-19 08:05:10Z)**_

This will register `<leader>t` as a "toggle" group in the which-key menu. Since keymaps are loaded on `VeryLazy`, which-key should already be available at that point.

The result will show `t → +toggle` in the which-key popup, and your `<leader>tp` will appear nested under it as "Toggle Copilot Auto Trigger".
